segments.expected: Kiva did not know where she had found a fish crate on a boarded-over timber pond. She supposed that Orla could find a crate anywhere, as some people could always find a chair in a full room. She was in her old coat with her stick across her knees, and she was watching the mast and not the queue. She did not look round when Seven came across the boards to her.
